method: Ten distinct queries through the app search API, at most 200 eBay results per query, Any profit/ROI, offers excluded, and up to two selected full analyses per query. This diagnostic run predates the final automatic-discovery changes. Representative browser checks followed.
limitations: Nine search streams completed; the broad vintage search was stopped at 150 seconds after price-provider rate limits.
Full analyses were sampled, not exhaustive. These timings are diagnostic observations, not guarantees or final-version benchmarks.
The eBay allowance changed by 399 during the run; concurrent app activity may contribute.

Share overlapping provider lookups, bound waits and honor cooldowns.

Make automatic discovery cancellable, cached, sampled and adaptive.
